note: HF chain correction (NonLin_program 11.6, fork D/F): complex log-gain at knots_hz per capture, exp(z) applied to the model above 10 kHz (unity <= 10 kHz and >= 12.8 kHz). z = z0 + s u; shape fitted on the other capture runs, s from the R front taps of the 15 nearest-in-time captures. Captures without a timestamp use `default`.
